nom: SkinMedica Even & Correct Brightening Treatment Pads For Face Exfoliating

avis.texte: I’ve been using these for about two years and swear by them! I have found they’ve helped with my melasma and helps keep my skin clear. I use them at bedtime after I wash my face before using my red light mask and putting on a night serum. When you first start using them you may feel a little tingle the first few times you use them, but it’s minor and goes away.

avis.titre: Did not even lighten my brown spots
avis.texte: I use these diligently and there was Zero difference in the brown spots on my skin. My brown spots are not incredibly dark. I don't know who this stuff worked for but definitely did not for me. Better off spending your money on a peel or laser lift.
